argument.script: async (intermediate) => { const text = '{{ text }}'; const max = {{ max }} || 20; const skipReplied = {{ skip_replied }} !== false; const ct0 = document.cookie.split(';').map(c=>c.trim()).find(c=>c.startsWith('ct0='))?.split('=')[1]; if (!ct0) return { error: 'Not logged into x.com' }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3000)); const conversationItems = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="dm-conversation-item-"]'); const results = []; for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(conversationItems.length, max); i++) { const item = conversationItems[i]; const header = item.querySelector('[data-testid="conversation-header"]'); const username = header?.textContent?.trim() || 'unknown'; if (skipReplied && item.querySelector('[data-testid="dmComposerTextInput"]')) continue; item.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000)); const input = document.querySelector('[data-testid="dmComposerTextInput"]'); if (!input) { results.push({ index: i + 1, status: 'skipped', user: username, message: 'No input found' }); continue; } input.focus(); try { document.execCommand('insertText', false, text); } catch { input.value = text; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); const sendBtn = document.querySelector('[data-testid="dmComposerSendButton"]'); if (sendBtn) sendBtn.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); results.push({ index: i + 1, status: 'sent', user: username, message: text.slice(0, 100) }); } return { results }; }
async (intermediate) => { if (intermediate.error) return [{ index: 0, status: 'error', user: '', message: intermediate.error }]; return intermediate.results || []; }
